mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_operation ( id, payment_id, operation_id, amount, currency, status, provider_reference, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{paymentId}, #{operationId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{status}, #{providerReference}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (operation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, operation_id, amount, currency, status, provider_reference, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_operation WHERE operation_id = #{operationId}
